name: opensees_wall_sfi_mvlem_five_story
reference: Kolozvari, Orakcal and Wallace (2015), Journal of Structural Engineering 141(5), 04014135, doi:10.1061/(ASCE)ST.1943-541X.0001059. Kolozvari, Tran, Orakcal and Wallace (2015), 04014136, doi:10.1061/(ASCE)ST.1943-541X.0001083. PEER Report 2015/12.
notes: Five-story wall-frame subjected to the published MCEScaledEQ1X acceleration. Requires FSAM, SFI_MVLEM and ModIMKPeakOriented. The original acceleration is pinned.
disabled_reason: The display procs are headless. In live replay, the initial transient solve stops at 35.16 s in Strut and 27.92 s in OpenSees. Strut also skips the SFI curvature, shear deformation, and RCPanel recorder responses required by this case.
